data.body: Criterion 1 verified on the box after deploy: review-bot container started 16:20:22 PST on 4bf065d8ac4 (bot-deployed-sha), deployed rebar.review_bot.voter has no _publish_voter_error_metric. Natural VOTER_ERROR markers at 16:45:02 and 17:05:03 PST (review timeouts; no error was induced). 1-minute Sum of rebar/host:voter_errors 16:15-17:30 PST: 13 datapoints, 2 nonzero, total 2 — 16:48 = 1 and 17:08 = 1, matching the rebar-health probe lines 'voter failures (new this interval)=1' at 16:48:38 and 17:08:45. No count at the error minutes. Before the fix the same pattern gave 2 counts per error (11-21: 06:15 + 06:20, 06:35 + 06:36).
